label: Australia
notes: Work rights are conventionally stated outright - 'Australian citizen', 'Permanent Resident' - because sponsorship capability is a genuine screening question. Hence required rather than expected.
Referees appear inline with names and contact details, unlike the US convention. Obtain consent before rendering: set referees[].consent.
Three to four pages is normal, not padding. Australian recruiters read longer documents than American ones.
Suburb and state rather than a street address.
Public-sector postings often require selection-criteria responses. Hold those as narratives[].kind: criterion-response and deliver them as a companion document, not a resume section.
